Short title and commencement

NORTH﷓WEST FRONTIER PROVINCE FINANCE
NORTH-WEST
FRONTIER PROVINCE FINANCE
(AMENDMENT) ACT,
1003
ACT I OF 2003
An Act further to
amend the North-West Frontier Province Finance Act, 1996
[Gazette of N.-W.
F. P., Extraordinary, 28th May, 2003]
No.
PA/NWFP/Legis-I/2003/14911, dated 28-5-2003.--The North.-West Frontier
Province Finance (Amendment) Bill, 2003, having been passed by the Provincial
Assembly of North-West FRONTIER Province on the 6th May, 2003 and assented to
by the Governor of the North-West Frontier Province on 23rd play, 2003 is
hereby published as an Act of the Provincial Legislature of North-West Frontier
Province.
1. Short title and
commencement.--(1) This act maybe called the North-West Frontier Province
Finance (Amendment) Act, 2003.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

sections.shortTitle: N -W F P Finance Amendment Ordinance 2003
sections.description:
Substitution of section 11 of N.-W.F.P. Act No. I of 1996

NORTH﷓WEST FRONTIER PROVINCE FINANCE
NORTH-WEST
FRONTIER PROVINCE FINANCE
(AMENDMENT) ACT,
1003
ACT I OF 2003
An Act further to
amend the North-West Frontier Province Finance Act, 1996
[Gazette of N.-W.
F. P., Extraordinary, 28th May, 2003]
No.
PA/NWFP/Legis-I/2003/14911, dated 28-5-2003.--The North.-West Frontier
Province Finance (Amendment) Bill, 2003, having been passed by the Provincial
Assembly of North-West FRONTIER Province on the 6th May, 2003 and assented to
by the Governor of the North-West Frontier Province on 23rd play, 2003 is
hereby published as an Act of the Provincial Legislature of North-West Frontier
Province.
2. Substitution of section 11
of N.-W.F.P. Act No. I of 1996.--In the North-West Frontier Province
Finance Act, 1996 (N.-W.F.P. Act No. I of 1996), for section 11 the following
shall be substituted, namely:--
"11.
Tobacco development cess.--(1) There shall be levied and collected development
cess on tobacco at the rate of two rupees per kilogram from---
(a) tobacco
manufacturing factories on the basis of quota fixed for the factory concerned
by the Pakistan tobacco Board; and
(b) persons,
other than tobacco factories, dealing in tobacco business, who are transporting
tobacco out side the district of its production:
Provided that
tobacco factories shall not be liable to pay the cess on tobacco on which cess
has already been paid under clause (b):
Provided further
that no cess shall be charged on the tobacco being transported, for which cess
has already been paid under clause (a).
(2) The cess for tobacco for the period
from 1-7-1997 to 30-6 -1998 (both days inclusive), recovered at the rate of
Rs.1.2 per K.G. shall, for all intents and purposes, be deemed to have been
validly recovered, as the said rate were fixed under this Act.
(3) The proceeds of the cess shall
be utilized for:--
(i) special maintenance and
development of roads, highways and special plant protection service in the
tobacco growing areas in the Province;
(ii) such activities as are
directed towards the development of tobacco production in the Province; and
(iii) maintenance and development
of 'infrastructure in the Province in such manner as may be prescribed.".
